meta.name: redesign-existing-projects
meta.description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将现有网站和应用的视觉设计提升至高端品质
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有设计粗糙的网站或应用，想在不破坏功能的前提下提升视觉品质
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade existing websites and apps to premium visual quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a rough-looking site or app and want to elevate its design without breaking functionality

howto.what: Claude 会审查你的网站或应用代码，找出设计上的常见问题，然后在不破坏现有功能的前提下，用更高级的设计标准进行改进。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 升级或重新设计一个已有的网站或应用项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我重新设计这个网站的排版和颜色。
say.note: Claude 会执行设计审计并应用改进。

say.text: 检查这个项目有哪些AI常见设计模式并修复。
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码并列出问题清单。

say.text: 给这个页面添加交互状态和动画。
say.note: Claude 会补充悬停、加载等状态和过渡效果。

howto.what_en: Claude audits your website or app code for common design issues, then applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality, upgrading typography, colors, layout, interactivity, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to upgrade or redesign an existing website or app project.

say_en.text: Redesign the typography and colors of this site.
say_en.note: Claude runs the design audit and applies fixes.

say_en.text: Check this project for generic AI patterns and fix them.
say_en.note: Claude scans code and lists issues.

say_en.text: Add hover states and loading animations to this page.
